positions.name: ProbeMemoryAsSelfInstrument
positions.frame: How does a test artifact use the pipeline's own vocabulary to frame itself as a self-referential instrument whose sole purpose is to carry a behavioral assertion about the system?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere under a single directional read: the pipeline's native vocabulary (e2e suite, asserts, enrolls, probe memory) is used to frame an artifact as a self-referential test instrument. src-1 performs the decision that the suite asserts a behavioral rule — saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer — while src-2 subordinates the probe memory's entire existence to carrying that assertion. The conviction gradient (src-1 ratifies as a decision; src-2 asserts as a claim) is internal tension the frame holds: the settling act and the instrumental justification are the same stance performed at different conviction levels.
